recruitment to a weight loss intervention trial during adjuvant chemotherapy and/or radiotherapy is feasible and can be achieved in a busy cancer center, but uptake is lower among women who are older and of lower socioeconomic status.

the Breast—Activity and Health Eating After Diagnosis ( B-AHEAD ) trial tested the effects of a diet and exercise programme versus a control receiving a leaflet during adjuvant breast cancer treatment.

the impact of lifestyle factors on breast cancer outcomes, and we have developed and tested a lifestyle intervention program for women undergoing treatment for breast cancer.

the uptake of lifestyle intervention studies at the time of breast cancer diagnosis and during adjuvant therapy is feasible, but barriers to uptake should be identified and overcome in order for future lifestyle intervention studies to be effective.
